table.name: TLGNC_WAGON
table.description: Wagons are used to deliver road orders and are owned by a carrier. WAGONs can have 2-5 axes (having a loading capacity itself) or be of the type semi-trailer WAGON, where the trailer defines the loading capacity. Many of the fields have only informative character and are ignored by Logon.

column.name: WAGON_NO
column.description: The complete wagon number comprises 12 digits, stored without formatting in DB, must be unique. Example (formatted) 2385 910 4 144-3. First and second position: Interoperability code (on multiple units Type code), Third and fourth position: Owner's code (since 2006: UIC country code), Fifth to eight position: Type number (fifth digit forms first letter of UIC classification), Ninth to eleventh position: Serial number, Twelfth position: Self-check digit. See http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/UIC_wagon_numbers

column.name: WAGON_TYPE_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_wagon_type. Crh wagon type (what the customer orders). Subtypes of UIC Classification to differiante individual build of wagon. ShipTos can only receive certain types (prioritized)

column.name: WAGON_INACTIVE_REASON_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_wagon_inactive_reason. Indicates the reason of wagon being inactive. Can only be set if activeFlag=0.

column.name: WAGON_NOTE_DISPOSITION
column.description: Note for disposition. Wagon-specific comment. To be shown whenever the wagon is dispatched.

column.name: WAGON_NOTE_RAILWAY_SPEDITION
column.description: Note for Railway Spedition (Parallel). Comment should be displayed in Parallel when wagon is selected to be loaded.

column.name: RETURN_SHIPTO_SAP_BP_ID
column.description: FK tlgns_sap_bp. Default return location to which the empty wagon is sent after order is finished. Must be a shipto with tlgnc_shipto.shipto_type_cd='Plant'. For the actual transportation request to SAP mainly the railway station (destination) is of interest but because a return order is a normal Logon order it is also modelled as from=shippingpoint, to=shipto.

column.name: LAST_KNOWN_RAILWAY_STATION_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_railway_station. The railway station where the wagon was last seen. If no new assignment with status > dispatched exists for this wagon this is also the 'current station' of the wagon. The value is NOT reset when a train leaves the station! The last known station is set when a) arrival messages are received from the railway company, b) a wagon is seen at a shippingpoint to be loaded, c) a wagon is scanned at a FVL (unloading into truck), d) corrected by an administrator, etc...

column.name: ARRIVAL_LAST_KNOWN_STATION_DAT
column.description: Date/Time of the arrival at the last_known_railway_station_id. NULL is only allowed when the station is also null (unknown). The date is updated when the station changes, independent of the type of event. However, if an event simply confirms the station (=still standing there), the arrival date is not updated, i.e. Logon tries to keep the original arrival information. If an administrator corrects the last known station, he should also set a (guessed) arrival date, for example 'now' (but not null!)

column.name: CURRENT_PLANT_TRACK_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_plant_track_bs. Track at the station/plant, where the wagon is currently standing. A track+position can only be taken by 1 wagon. This information is updated during the rail-disposition/switching. When a departure message is received, the track+position is set to null. If the departure is not registered (but it should have), the dispatcher should manually clear these fields in the wagon administration.

column.name: CURRENT_TRACK_POSITION_NO
column.description: Position of the wagon within the 'train' standing on the track defined by current_plant_track_cd.

column.name: SAP_VEHICLE_NO
column.description: SAP Number of the wagon. Field is going to be used in export interfaces to SAP.

column.name: MAX_GROSS_WEIGHT_T
column.description: Maximal gross weight. This is the legal max weight for the wagon from the railroad company, e.g. because of axle load. TODO ADN 47233: Logic not yet 100%, but add to 1.1 DB for now (to have it at correct place in the schema).

column.name: TARE_WEIGHT_T
column.description: Weight of the empty wagon in tons. Typically this is measured in steps of 10kg. The difference between this SHOULD-tare-weight and the actual tare weight is relevant when loading a wagon because of material compatibility and return quantity, see also limit_credit_note_t.

column.name: WRITTEN_TARE_WEIGHT_T
column.description: Written weight of the empty wagon in tons. No logic in Logon.

column.name: VOLUME_M3
column.description: Loading capacity of the wagon in cubic meters/Laderaum. If null: use tlgnr_wagon_type_cd.volume_m3 instead. For certain wagon-material combinations the volume is the limiting factor (instead of just max_net_load_t), see the so-called 'Schuettdichte' of a material, tlgnc_mat_plant.bulk_density_kgpm3.

column.name: LIMIT_CREDIT_NOTE_T
column.description: Default is taken from wagon type. If null: use tlgnr_wagon_type_cd.limit_credit_note_t.

column.name: LOADING_LIMIT_A_T
column.description: Load limit A in tons/Lastgrenze A in Tonnen. No logic in Logon currently.

column.name: LOADING_LIMIT_B_T
column.description: Load limit B in tons/Lastgrenze B in Tonnen. No logic in Logon currently.

column.name: LOADING_LIMIT_C_T
column.description: Load limit C in tons/Lastgrenze C in Tonnen. No logic in Logon currently.

column.name: LOADING_LIMIT_D_T
column.description: Load limit D in tons/Lastgrenze D in Tonnen. No logic in Logon currently.

column.name: WHEELBASE_BPP_MM
column.description: Wheelbase Bogie Pivot Pitch in millimeter/Radstand DZA in Millimeter

column.name: BUFFER_LENGTH_MM
column.description: Length over buffer in millimeter/Laenge ueber Puffer in Millimeter

column.name: WHEELSET_1_NBS_DIAMETER_MM
column.description: wheelset 1 NBS diameter in millimeter/Radsatz 1 NBS Durchmesser in Millimetern

column.name: WHEELSET_1_NBS_YEAR
column.description: wheelset 1 NBS year/Radsatz 1 NBS Jahr. Values are Year.Month (e.g. 2010.10). 2010.00 has the meaning '2010, month not known/relevant', 2010.1 = 2010.10 = October. 2010.13 etc has no meaning and is not allowed to enter in the application.

column.name: RFIDOBJECT_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_rfid_object. The ID which is used to associate this object (wagon) with RFID tags. An RFID object can have several RFID tags.

column.name: ETRAN_RETURN
column.description: The ETRAN DN number for empty trips (to send the wagons back to the plant).

column.name: ETRAN_OUTBOUND
column.description: The ETRAN DN number for loaded wagons (sent to the customer).
